findings.title: Kiosk paid-at-creation contract correctly enforced server-side
evidence: app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:236 — `shouldDispatchNewOrderSignals = !isKioskOrderType || isCounterDeferredKioskCash || !isKioskPaymentMethod` — kiosk card/TR orders NEVER dispatch OrderCreated at create time; deferred until TPE callback flips ps=PAID.

app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:1066..1218 — `finalizePaidKioskOrder` gates fiscal_sequence allocation behind `payment_status === PAID` (line 1107) defense-in-depth even though controller pre-checks.
app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:265 — at-creation `payment_status` is `PENDING_COUNTER` only for cash (auto-accept), `UNPAID` otherwise; status stays `PENDING` until TPE confirms.
app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:1192 — `OrderStatus::ACCEPT` promotion happens INSIDE same transaction as fiscal alloc; rollback consistency guaranteed.
findings.assessment: F-002 round-3 truth table fully implemented. NF525 invariant 'kiosk paid = at-creation allocation' literally means: allocation happens at the moment payment is confirmed, NOT at the bare order-create POST. This is the correct interpretation — early allocation would create fiscal gaps for declined TPE.

findings.title: Composition snapshot frozen at create (NF525 SSOT contract)
evidence: app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php:266..297 — composition_snapshot built via `CompositionSnapshotBuilder->build()` then `json_encode` directly into the bulk-insert row (Eloquent 'array' cast bypassed because mass-insert).
app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:466 — kiosk legacy path (non-SSOT) ALSO builds + json_encodes composition_snapshot, parity preserved.

app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:294 — `OrderItem::insert($itemsArray)` is the single write; no UPDATE path on composition_snapshot exists in the codebase (verified by grep). NF525 immutability honored.
findings.assessment: Composition snapshot is the fiscal SSOT for reprint/Z-export. The fact that BOTH the SSOT path (PricingService) and the legacy fallback path (FrontendOrderService inline) emit identical structures means no class of finding can claim 'composition_snapshot diverges between kiosk paths'. KEEP.

The kiosk wizard FROZEN contract is the source of truth; cross-surface verification belongs to whichever consumer touches mobile/data/menu.js. Architect surface here = the wizard hands the cart an item with `{ item_id, quantity, item_variations[], item_extras[] }` shape — that contract is verified in OrderRequest line 182 (`items` JSON validator `ValidJsonOrder`) and FrontendOrderService:273 (`safeJsonDecode($request->items)`).

findings.title: FROZEN wizard hands cart a stable contract; cart→quote→submit chain symmetric
evidence: resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js:603..620 — `quoteOrder` gates on `state.kioskToken` (no token = no quote, prevents 401 silent fail) — Wave E state 04 heal.
resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskPaymentComponent.vue:486..510 — `refreshQuote` mirrors same gate (`if (!this.$store.state.kioskCart?.kioskToken)` throws `KIOSK_QUOTE_NO_TOKEN`).

resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskPaymentComponent.vue:373..395 — `submitOrder` returns the server-truth `total` (from `OrderDetailsResource.total`) and uses `quote.total_ttc` as the SSOT for cart→pay surface display.
findings.assessment: Quote→pay→confirm chain is symmetric across cart and payment components. Both gate on the same token state. KEEP.

findings.title: FrontendOrderService `myOrderStore` is dual-purpose (kiosk + web/mobile)
evidence: app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:131..170 — comment block explicitly documents 'route /api/frontend/order is dual-purpose (kiosk + web/mobile users)'.
Line 199 — `$isKioskMachineOrder = (bool) $kiosk;` driver of every branching decision (KioskMachine row presence).
Line 144..151 — branch_id resolution falls back to `Auth::user()?->branch_id` then 422 if zero — closes the cross-branch idempotency leak the F-007 heal targeted.
findings.assessment: BY-DESIGN dual-purpose. Splitting into a dedicated `KioskOrderService` would be a V1.0.2 refactor with regression risk — not actionable now. Surface this for reviewers who might suspect 'kiosk logic in a service called Frontend should be split'.

wizard_4_template_parity_check.rationale: Mobile/data/menu.js is standalone with separate audit master per architect mandate; cross-reading it here would create scope creep and duplicate Mobile Realignment work. The FROZEN wizard contract surface (item_id + quantity + item_variations[] + item_extras[]) is already validated by `ValidJsonOrder` (resources/rules) and the SSOT `CompositionSnapshotBuilder` which is template-agnostic.
wizard_4_template_parity_check.what-would-trigger-real-divergence: If mobile shipped a 5th template (e.g. tacos with cheese-step) that the kiosk wizard didn't recognize, the cart line would still arrive at the backend with valid {item_id, item_variations[]} — the backend doesn't know about templates; it just hydrates by IDs. Template parity is a UX concern, not a data-integrity one.
